scope.en: A dated administrative reference, including recorded claims. It does not map military fronts, uniform occupation, Indigenous sovereignty or all competing jurisdictions. Source dates and representative names remain inspectable.
scope.zh: 有年代依据的行政参照，包含来源记录的主张；不表示战线、均匀占领、原住民族主权或全部竞争管辖。保留来源年代与代表名称供查阅。

CAN.datasetVersion: NRCan2017 catalog release, pinned by archive SHA256

method.USA: Source START_N/END_N, sampled at December31. Gadsden signing-date start deferred to1854 for transfer interpretation. Other-type and Oregon joint-occupation units do not become US federal extent.
method.CAN: Use explicit HISTO snapshot year, not broad START_TIME/END_TIME values. Select latest snapshot within1867–2003; each is a dated contextual reference until the next source stage, not an annual survey.
method.geometry: Reproject NRCan EPSG3978 to EPSG4326; topology-preserving simplification .04 degrees (Canada)/.02 degrees (US); round .0001 degrees; normalize D3 ring winding; retain individual source units; share display colors by parent without merging identities.
method.limits: Canada stages omit some intermediate administrative changes; US source administrative frames do not reproduce Civil War fronts or establish Indigenous title.
